caption: The drawing depicts a single, curved, ribbon-like object with an embossed or carved botanical design on its surface. The object appears to be rendered in shades of green, yellow, brown, and hints of ochre, giving it the appearance of a metal or wood piece with a patina or aged finish. The surface decoration includes flowing lines that form leaves, stems, and a central bud or closed flower, all in low relief. The left end of the ribbon curves backward and partially inward, and the right end is squared off and shaded in brown to suggest thickness and dimensionality. The entire form sits against a plain, off-white background, and there is a subtle signature reading "Harry Jennings" near the bottom right of the image.
title: Tie-back
